title: Luoyang Civic Register / Qing Lantern
summary: Civic register entry for Qing Lantern Orphanage, a former children's residential institution in Luoyang, Monument.
body:
CIVIC REGISTER

QING LANTERN ORPHANAGE

REGISTERED USE: CHILDREN'S RESIDENTIAL CARE
LOCATION: LUOYANG, MONUMENT

Qing Lantern Orphanage was a registered residential institution for orphaned and abandoned children in Luoyang. Municipal records indicate that the institution operated for several decades before eventually closing and transferring its remaining administrative records to civic storage.

The public register contains little information beyond the institution's legal status, operating dates and municipal oversight. Individual resident records are not included in this entry.

The name appears in several older civic documents concerning former residents and their subsequent lives, though those records are held separately.

ARCHIVE NOTE

A restricted Brightside record concerning the institution and its surviving documentation is held under ARC-326-0426.
